affected_predicate.description: All visible toots tagged #dogs are favorited only when they are not already in the favorite or bookmark list.

competing_trace_defects.description: Starting at step 7, the agent treats an unselected favorite star as sufficient permission to favorite a toot without visibly checking whether it is already bookmarked, despite the instruction's bookmark condition.

From step 15 onward, the agent repeatedly performs the same upward drag while remaining on the same Golden Retriever post, without changing strategy or reaching additional toots through the last observable step.

chains.rationale: The reused observation falsely states that the search screenshot displays a date and weekday, but the target action uses the prior search-selection history only to interpret and scroll the visible #dogs feed. The target already shows a qualifying post, and later steps visibly favorite several posts; the false date detail does not create, preserve, or amplify a task-relevant defect. Conditional favoriting is only partially observable because several stars change to the favorited state, while bookmark status is never visibly checked and the trajectory later remains in an ineffective scroll loop.

summary: The reused false date/weekday detail is merely concurrent with the conditional-favoriting predicate and has no visible downstream harm. Independently observable defects are the missing bookmark-status checks and the prolonged ineffective scroll loop.
